verdict.rationale: Stripe's Invoicing integration docs say official libraries exist for accessing the Stripe API, and the Invoicing API is documented for automation, so the product does ship first-party SDKs. The evidence is only a single mention, though: no languages, install steps, versioning or invoicing-specific SDK examples are shown. missing for 10: supported-language list and SDK reference docs, invoicing-specific SDK code samples, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
